before.content:
echo "usage: ./ji relay up|status|down" >&2
  exit 2
fi
case "${2:-}" in
  up)
    docker compose -p ji-relay -f deploy/relay/compose.yaml up -d --build --wait
    ;;
  status)
    docker compose -p ji-relay -f deploy/relay/compose.yaml ps

after.content:
printf '\n'
    ;;
  down)
    $compose down
    ;;
  *)
    echo "usage: ./ji relay up|status|down" >&2
